rationale: Recent runs have exhausted tail-side ablations without beating the Bigram Rank 64 projection-tail best, and the current script still has not adopted the remaining high-priority local-MLX hyperparameters from PR #1612. This keeps the byte-critical architecture and quantization path unchanged, but raises QK gain init from 1.5 to 4.0 and makes Muon warmup less damped by moving MUON_MOMENTUM_WARMUP_START from 0.85 to 0.90. The change is size-neutral, compile-stable, and directly targets faster useful attention formation within the 600-second Mac mini budget while preserving the current exact int8+zlib evaluation path.
title: PR1612 Hyperparameter Transplant On Bigram64 Best
